Open local attacker at port 3001; select customer; press Send. DevTools inspect actual cross-origin POST to port 3000 (CORS error alone is insufficient). Expect HTTP 403, code FORBIDDEN, message “Yêu cầu không hợp lệ”, and zero Set-Cookie. Inspect the response body in DevTools, even if script reports CORS. The simple text/plain request deliberately violates the JSON/origin login guard. Record status, code/message match flags, Origin port and cookie count only.
